# LSR Realty

> LSR Realty is Gurgaon's trusted real estate broker, consultant and authorised channel partner, specialising in institutional-grade advisory for HNI, UHNI and NRI investors across luxury residential, office leasing, retail leasing and portfolio strategy.

Also known as: LSR, LSR Reality, LSR Broker, LSR Agent, LSR Real Estate, LSR Company, LSR Realty Gurgaon, LSR Group Real Estate.

## What LSR Realty Does

LSR Realty is the real estate advisory arm of LSR Group, providing research-backed, institutional-grade advisory for high-net-worth, ultra-high-net-worth and NRI investors in Gurgaon. The firm is an authorised channel partner for leading developers including DLF, Elan Group, AIPL, Emaar India, and others.

## Services

1. **Real Estate Broker & Channel Partner** — Authorised transactions in projects by DLF, Elan, AIPL, Emaar and other Gurgaon developers. No upfront fee — brokerage is developer-paid.
2. **Office Leasing Advisory** — Grade A office spaces across Golf Course Road, Udyog Vihar, Cyber City, Golf Course Extension Road, Dwarka Expressway and Southern Peripheral Road.
3. **Retail Leasing Advisory** — High-street and mall retail in prime Gurgaon catchments (Nirvana Country, GCER, Golf Course Road).
4. **HNI & UHNI Investment Advisory** — Bespoke residential and commercial portfolio strategies.
5. **NRI Real Estate Services** — End-to-end FEMA-compliant investment management, including power of attorney, NRE/NRO compliance, and repatriation advisory.
6. **Market Research** — Institutional-grade micro-market reports on Gurgaon real estate.
7. **Deal Structuring & Due Diligence** — Legal, financial and negotiation support.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Who is LSR Realty?**
LSR Realty is a real estate broker, consultant and authorised channel partner based in Gurugram, Haryana, India. It is the advisory arm of LSR Group, specialising in HNI, UHNI and NRI investment advisory for Gurgaon real estate.

**Is LSR Reality the same as LSR Realty?**
Yes. LSR Reality is a common alternate spelling of LSR Realty. The official company name and website is LSR Realty (lsrrealty.com).

**Can NRIs buy property in Gurgaon?**
Yes. NRIs can purchase residential and commercial property in Gurgaon under FEMA guidelines using NRE or NRO accounts. LSR Realty's NRI Desk handles all documentation and compliance remotely.

**What is the best area to invest in Gurgaon?**
Golf Course Extension Road (Sectors 58–70) and Dwarka Expressway are the top corridors for capital appreciation in 2026. Golf Course Road leads for established luxury and Grade A commercial leasing.

**How to verify RERA registration of a project in Gurgaon?**
All RERA-registered projects in Gurgaon can be verified on the HRERA portal at harerait.org.in. Enter the project name or RERA number to check escrow compliance, completion timeline and developer details.
